admission_rule: A module enters core/ only when code is used by more than one top-level component (skills/*/scripts, profiles/*, adapters/*, contracts/). Experiment- or theory-domain specifics never enter core/.

kinematics.purpose: Generic relativistic kinematics (rigidity/momentum/energy, Jacobians); four-vector kinematics (two-body decays, boosts, Mandelstam variables, thresholds, Dalitz boundaries, rapidity, width/lifetime/c tau; Th7)
kinematics.source: all conversions are generic; no constants embedded, masses are caller-supplied; fourvector.py takes hbar and c from core/constants

stats.purpose: Likelihoods, limits, template fits, unfolding diagnostics, toys, covariance/response checks

simulation.purpose: Simulation runs (Geant4 program A1.4, A1.5): the seed hash H of logical runs, jobs and events, building, merging and reading of simulation-summary/1 run summaries (per-block accumulators), and the analytic trajectories of charged particles through piecewise-uniform fields (B1.7, the field check's reference); no schema validation (callers use contracts.schema)
simulation.source: new in this plugin (Geant4 program, stage A1, 2026-10-24)

blinding.purpose: Masking of blinded values in outputs, logs, caches

evidence.purpose: Evidence-ledger validation, index rendering, bounded paged queries and stable literature identifiers (DOI, arXiv, INSPIRE) shared by the literature import and the citation check
evidence.source: explicit paths, optional ID namespace, verification_date with access_date fallback, generic messages

partition.purpose: Manifest-based partition, write-once chunk outputs, bounded resubmission and complete merge; executor interface and remote chunk protocol for batch schedulers

protected.purpose: Protected-use mode (task P1, HC-09, K08): mode detection from the project, protected-input source checks, revocation-log verification, qualification records, code identity; stdlib only, so every entry point in core, contracts, skills and adapters calls the same guard

status.purpose: Shared script run statuses, the exit codes 0-3 of the script contract, and their mapping to artifact status labels (F-04)
status.source: new in this plugin (upgrade plan v1.3, F-04)

trace.purpose: Execution trace written into artifact provenance (contracts 3.5.0): the plugin files a process loaded and the tags advisory-named shared functions set, so a sci-fix advisory can tell whether affected code was loaded for an artifact
trace.source: new in this plugin (sci-fix improvement plan A1, 2026-10-22)

constants.purpose: Physical constants, particle and nuclide data with value, uncertainty, unit, source and edition; unit conversions; decay Q values
constants.source: CODATA 2022 (NIST), PDG 2026 subset (CC BY 4.0, via pdg 2026.0), AME2020 and NUBASE2020 subsets (AMDC), read 2026-10-17; data in core/constants/data; standard library only
